title: Shadow Route Feasibility Report
description: Output of Tools/route-feasibility/hk_route_report (spec section 18.4), written to artifacts/shadow-route-feasibility.json. Cross-references shadow-hook-manifest.schema.json targets against HookKit's engine capability descriptors and ProviderEvidence, per packaging lane. This is the ABI-freeze gate input (spec section 18.5): freeze does not happen while any mandatory target across any supported lane lacks either a route or a documented platform/product decision here.

manifest_version.description: manifest_version of the shadow-hook-manifest.schema.json input this report was generated from.

unclassified_mandatory_targets.description: Must be 0 for the ABI-freeze gate (spec section 18.5) to be considered met.

lane.description: "all" is a lane-agnostic shorthand for passes with no real per-lane differentiation yet (e.g. a modeled classification not yet backed by per-lane ProviderEvidence) — one entry instead of four identical ones. A generator must switch to the 4 real lane names as soon as its classification can actually differ between them; "all" is for genuinely uniform results, not a permanent shortcut.

stable_hook_id.description: References the same field in shadow-hook-manifest.schema.json.

blocking_reason.description: null when selected_route is non-null. Otherwise a specific, non-generic reason (e.g. "no certified engine achieves HK_REACH_PRIVATE_ADDRESS under HK_CONTINUATION_FORBIDDEN on this lane") — never a bare "unsupported".

disposition.description: redesign_recommended/drop_recommended must carry a blocking_reason explaining what current Shadow behavior can't be preserved and why.
